title: kb pack's batched read takes a Git path that is not UTF-8 as path by path does
summary: When `kb pack` reads a commit in batches, a native file whose Git path is not UTF-8 is no longer read under the path's lossy decoding: reading that name gives what reading it path by path gives, normally `Selected committed regular non-executable blob unavailable`. The listing's name-byte limit counts each path's bytes as Git wrote them.
